title: Foreskin Warrior — Episode 1: First Battle, Double Barrier
description: My name is Yuji Saeki. I'm thirty-one. By day, I'm a mild-mannered clerk in Accounts. By night, I'm a warrior. My battlefields are locker rooms and communal baths.
markdown:
My name is Yuji Saeki. I'm thirty-one. By day, I'm a mild-mannered clerk in Accounts. By night, I'm a warrior. My battlefields are locker rooms and communal baths. And tonight, at a hot spring inn on our annual company trip, I face my first real battle. I have exactly one thing to protect: no colleague must ever find out I have a tight foreskin. The moment I pushed through the cloth curtain into the changing room, I sensed the enemy beyond the steam. My section chief, Mori from my intake year, and a gang of cheerful new hires, all laughing.

First technique: the Delaying Formation. Earlier, I had tied the sash of my cotton inn robe in a deliberate double knot. Now I fumbled with it, pretending it was stuck, and bought myself time. Out of the corner of my eye I counted them as they stripped and disappeared through the glass door to the baths. One. Two. Three. Good. The room was empty. Now. I wrapped a towel around my waist, then wrapped a second one over it. My ultimate defense, the Double Barrier, was complete. The man in the mirror looked every inch a fully armored warrior.

Inside the bathhouse, where everyone scrubs down on little stools before getting in the water, I activated my second technique: the Farthest Shower. I marched straight to the last station against the back wall, as far from the door as physically possible. There I deployed an advanced skill, washing myself while seated with a towel draped over my lap. Then Mori's voice rang out behind me. "Saeki, why are you wearing two towels? Who are you, a princess?" Everyone roared. My face went hot. My heart sounded the alarm. Steady. A warrior never shows weakness.

"I've been getting cold easily lately," I said, unleashing my signature excuse: the Poor Circulation Shield. Feeling cold. At a hot spring. Even I knew it was weak. The section chief chuckled, "Rough luck at your age," and the conversation drifted to next month's year-end accounts. Saved. But the trials weren't over. "Hey, Saeki, let's hit the outdoor bath." The open-air bath was a battlefield with no cover at all. Towels aren't allowed in the water, so stepping in meant taking mine off. It meant walking into enemy territory unarmed.

I stood with my back to the edge of the pool and waited. The instant everyone tilted their heads up at the night sky, I whipped off the towel and sank to my shoulders in one move. Secret art: the Underwater Vanishing Step. That the spring water was milky and opaque could only be heaven's blessing. But I couldn't stay in long. Getting out would mean the same danger all over again. Faking a head rush from the heat, I spoke up before anyone else could. "Sorry, I'm heading back to the room. Early start tomorrow." Tomorrow was nothing but sightseeing. There was no reason in the world to be up early.

I slipped back into my robe while the changing room was empty and finally let out a breath. The secret was safe. On paper, a victory. And yet the face reflected in the hallway window didn't look like a winner's at all. Laughter echoed from the distant baths. I hadn't been part of that circle. First battle: a draw. The war has only just begun.

---

*This is a work of fiction inspired by common, rarely spoken worries. Luca Bloom is a small team in Tokyo that makes a foreskin care tool for adult men. It is a general personal care product, not a medical device. If anything worries you, please talk to your doctor.*
